purpose: Teach: マリオ/マーティン/スティーブン/コリン/ティム/アレックス/ニコラ/アーサー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスーパーマリオのゲームをお孫様と楽しまれた
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he used to enjoy playing Super Mario with his grandchildren.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Voice settles into the memory. Warm but tinged with distance. Slow, unhurried pace — the cadence of someone savoring a detail from long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、マーティン・ルーサー・キングの演説を聴かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and you remember, dear — when you were young, you used to listen to Martin Luther King's speeches, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, knowing tease in the voice. Playful turnabout — she's gently ribbing him for his own nostalgia. Warm lilt at the end, inviting him to remember along with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスティーブン・キングの小説を愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was devoted to Stephen King's novels.
lines.style: Same reflective tone as before. Specific, tender attention on the detail. Voice lingers slightly on 'devoted' — not hurried. The patience of someone sharing something he cherished knowing she'll understand.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、コリン・パウエル氏の演説を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — you used to watch Colin Powell's speeches back when you were young, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing warmth with a hint of playful persistence. She's building a gentle pattern now, mirroring his moves. Voice has rhythm to it — almost teasing, but never unkind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがティム・バートン映画祭に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was passionate about Tim Burton films — went to every festival he could.
lines.style: Same measured, wistful tone. Voice carries a touch more brightness on 'passionate' — he's allowing himself to enjoy the memory. Still unhurried, but there's a slight warmth in the pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、アレックス・カトラー氏の楽曲を愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — back when you were young, you loved Alex Cutler's music dearly, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle rhythm continues. Voice has a knowing lilt — she's enjoying this exchange now. Warm, almost conspiratorial, like she's reminding him of something he'd forgotten about himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがニコラ・テスラの伝記に夢中だった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was completely absorbed in Nikola Tesla's biography.
lines.style: Voice carries the same reflective quality but with a note of wonder at the intensity. Slow delivery on 'absorbed' — letting the word breathe. Tender underneath, acknowledging his father's passion.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、アーサー・C・クラークのSFを愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and you, dear — you used to love Arthur C. Clarke's science fiction when you were young, didn't you?
lines.style: Final turn: voice has warmth and light amusement. The rhythm is established now, almost musical. A gentle smile audible in the tone. She's won this little game, and they both know it.
